dataClusters.label: Asset Groups

strategies.label: Strategies
strategies.desc: Write strategies as Python functions in the in app editor, or describe them in English and let Fintelligent generate the code, parameters, and ranges.

fitness.label: Fitness
fitness.desc: Compose objective functions from 20+ metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, max drawdown) and reuse them across studies.

studies.label: Studies
studies.desc: Launch thousands of trials in parallel. intelligent optimization focuses search on promising regions; results validated on train, val, and out of sample windows.

portfolios.label: Portfolios
portfolios.desc: Browse ranked portfolios, full equity curves, parameter importance, and trade level drill down. Export PDF reports on demand.

riskManagers.label: Risk Managers

connectBroker.label: Connect Broker

features.title: Built for
features.description: Fintela is the AI-native solution for quantitative statistical validation: agentic AI that runs the platform for you, robust statistical validation at every stage, and intelligent optimization over thousands of trials, from idea to live capital, all in one workspace.

ai.title: AI that operates the platform
ai.description: Fintelligent drafts strategies, launches studies, attaches risk managers, and explains results in plain English, wired directly into your data and the platform's own actions.

dataAnalysis.title: Every dataset behind your strategies
dataAnalysis.description: Browse the full data library powering the platform, coverage, freshness, and raw records per ticker, plus a full robustness, clustering, and optimization report for any search.

python.title: Python first, no setup
python.description: Plain Python strategies in app with NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, ta, CVXPY. Named parameters, typed ranges, version history. Zero local install.

bayesian.title: intelligent optimization
bayesian.description: Seven samplers, TPE by default, search thousands of trials and validate every result on train, validation, and out-of-sample splits automatically.

strategyClustering.title: See your distinct strategies
strategyClustering.description: Cluster optimization trials by equity curve correlation to reveal genuinely distinct strategies, their representative curves, and which family holds your best trial.

paramImportances.title: Know which knobs matter
paramImportances.description: fANOVA and mean decrease impurity reveal each hyperparameter's share of performance variance, with train vs. validation contrast to flag overfitting and bootstrap confidence intervals.

metaStrategies.title: Meta strategies on baskets
metaStrategies.description: Portfolios of portfolios: feed basket equity curves into higher level strategies for capital allocation. Basket holdings can also be read as signals. Meta portfolios trade live like any strategy.

allocation.title: Portfolio allocation
allocation.description: Weight baskets with risk parity, volatility targeting, and momentum/mean reversion tilts. Identical in backtest and live. Basic methods free; advanced unlock per basket with tokens.

crossMarket.title: Cross market by design
crossMarket.description: One strategy engine across equities, indices, ETFs, forex and global markets. One mental model, every asset class.

liveTrading.title: Live long/short trading
liveTrading.description: Promote any backtested portfolio to live execution through your connected brokerage with real time order logs and one click pause.

privacy.title: Private by default, shared on your terms
privacy.description: Keep everything private, then share selectively with colleagues or your organization. Publish results only dashboards that hide code and hyperparameters.

quantum.title: Explore parameter space with a
quantum.description: Wrap your hyperparameter search in a quantum optimization algorithm, run on an emulated quantum computer. Your simulations and fitness stay classical and unchanged. Only the search itself goes quantum.

qaoa.title: QAOA optimization
qaoa.desc: We recast your search space as a QUBO and let the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm, running on a quantum circuit simulator, decide where to look next.

qkernel.title: Quantum kernel Bayesian search
qkernel.desc: A Gaussian process search whose kernel is measured from a quantum feature map, comparing configurations inside a quantum state space.

hardwareReady.title: Emulated today, hardware ready tomorrow
hardwareReady.desc: Built on PennyLane: the very same study can target real quantum processors (AWS Braket, IBM Quantum) the day you flip the switch.

quantum.note: Experimental. An emulator is a research tool and a bridge to real quantum hardware: it reimagines how the search explores, not how fast it runs.

fintelAgent.title: An AI that actually
fintelAgent.description: Not a chatbot pasted on top. Fintelligent is wired into your data sources and the platform's actions, built to do the work, not just describe it.

readsData.title: Reads your data
readsData.desc: Any metric, any equity curve, any trade, any study, answered in plain English with sources.

generatesStrategies.title: Generates strategies
generatesStrategies.desc: Describe an idea, and Fintelligent writes the Python, configures parameters, and stages the form for review.

operatesUi.title: Operates the UI
operatesUi.desc: "Open study 8 and clone it." "Switch to Markets." Pages and actions reachable by intent.

transparent.title: Transparent by design
transparent.desc: Tool calls are visible, and irreversible actions wait for your explicit confirmation.

fullCapabilities.heading: Everything Fintelligent can do for you
fullCapabilities.subheading: Ten ways it works inside Fintela, always under your control, and with your confirmation before anything that spends or can't be undone.

strategyBuilder.title: Turns an idea into a strategy ready to test
strategyBuilder.desc: Describe what you want in plain language and Fintelligent writes the code, picks the data, and validates the strategy before saving it.
bullets: Writes the Python code and defines the parameters to optimize.
Picks the data sources it needs, without you having to know how they connect.
Validates against real data before saving, and fixes it if something fails, then re-validates.
Does the same for fitness functions, risk managers, asset groups, and studies.

researchMindset.title: Reasons like a quant researcher, not a code generator
researchMindset.desc: When you bring an idea with a reason behind it, or an academic paper, it doesn't jump to the first code it can write: it sharpens the thesis with you first.
bullets: Proposes alternative mechanisms and recommends one, keeping a record of what it ruled out.
Checks the data actually exists on the platform before writing a single line.
Pre-registers success criteria before launching the search, so the out-of-sample result is judged once, honestly.
Always distinguishes what it verified with data, what's its own judgment, and what it assumed.

evidenceAnalysis.title: Analyzes your studies and portfolios with evidence
evidenceAnalysis.desc: Ask anything about your workspace in plain language and get answers backed by real numbers.
bullets: Study status: progress, errors, and which ones are worth resuming with more trials.
Overfitting detection: overfitting probability, deflated Sharpe, validation-to-OOS degradation.
A portfolio's risk profile, plus what-if simulations like inverting signals or shortening the window.
Sees exactly what you see on screen, and answers about it without you having to describe it.

marketResearch.title: Researches the market
marketResearch.desc: Conversational access to Fintela's entire market data universe.
bullets: Market overview: indices, sectors, countries, rates, earnings calendar.
By ticker: prices and history, fundamentals, sentiment, insider activity, news.
Screener: filters the market by whatever you describe and turns the result into an asset group.
Summaries of current conditions, in a paragraph or a full report.

pdfReports.title: Generates PDF reports
pdfReports.desc: With one message, Fintelligent writes and downloads a report with sections, tables, and charts.
bullets: Study report: configuration, optimization history, parameter importance, overfitting diagnostics.
Portfolio report: per-stage metrics, parameters, holdings, and risk, ready for an investment committee.
Market report: overview, specific tickers, or the analysis you ask for.
Generated right in your browser: no document is ever stored anywhere else.

platformOperator.title: Operates the platform for you
platformOperator.desc: Takes you to the right page, opens the editor you need, and fills in the forms.
bullets: Chains actions: search for a resource, open it, edit fields, validate, request a save.
Asks you only when it genuinely needs to, leading with its own recommendation and reasonable defaults for the rest.
Links to resources by name so you can click straight through.

teaches.title: Teaches as it works
teaches.desc: Speaks equally well to an experienced quant and to someone who's never built a strategy.
bullets: Defines each concept the first time it comes up, then stops once you show fluency.
With a new user, asks about goals in human terms and translates the answers into platform configuration.
Guides the build of your first portfolio step by step: universe → strategy → objective → study → selection.
Explains results in plain language, with the precise metric in parentheses.

backgroundWork.title: Keeps working even when you're not watching
backgroundWork.desc: Keeps going if you switch pages, switch tabs, or close the browser.
bullets: Validates, fixes, and saves on the server: not just on your screen.
Persistent drafts: unfinished work waits for you to review, edit, or discard when you come back.
An activity indicator and notifications bring you back when it's done or needs you.
Resumes from any device, including mobile.

safety.title: Full control and security
safety.desc: Nothing that spends money or can't be undone happens without your explicit confirmation.
bullets: Never deletes anything: removing a resource is always your own action, from the interface.
Never trades live: strictly read-only on portfolios that are in operation.
Only sees what you see, within your own organization and permissions.
Every action is logged: who requested it, when, and exactly what changed.

oneClickIdeas.title: One-click ideas on your portfolio groups
oneClickIdeas.desc: In every portfolio group's Ideas tab, it proposes concrete improvements from each asset's real contribution to the result.
bullets: Change the rebalance cadence, the allocation method, or exclude a name or a sector.
Every idea is tested with one click: the engine re-simulates the group and shows the exact delta on each metric.
The AI proposes; the engine always computes the numbers.

model.description: Model the asset price deviation relative to a long-term moving average as a 2nd order differential equation to capture instantaneous price velocity (momentum) and acceleration.
model.chatText: Build a quantitative long-only strategy modeling price deviation x(t) = P(t) - MovingAverage(100) using a 2nd order damped differential equation. Compute velocity dx/dt and acceleration d2x/dt2 using finite differences.
bullets: Models velocity (1st derivative) and acceleration (2nd derivative) of price relative to trend.
Prevents lag inherent in traditional momentum indicators.
Filters out false breakouts before critical damping occurs.

score.description: Combine positive differential acceleration with sustained relative volume (RVOL) to rank candidate assets while ensuring price trades above the long-term trend filter.
score.chatText: Filter for assets where P(t) > MA(100). Calculate a composite score rewarding positive acceleration d2x/dt2 accompanied by elevated multi-period RVOL, ignoring single-day volume spikes.
bullets: Requires P(t) > MA(100) to ensure long-only alignment.
Rewards continuous institutional volume expansion.
Eliminates reliance on single-day outlier spikes.

allocation.description: Rank the entire investment universe by composite score, select the top n_top assets, and apply equal-weight portfolio allocation with periodic rebalancing.
allocation.chatText: Rank all universe assets by the differential score. Select n_top = 10 assets and assign equal weights (10% each). Auto-rotate out assets that fall below the top 10 on monthly rebalance.
bullets: Strict n_top position capping for risk control.
Automatic exit rule when an asset drops out of top ranking.
Configurable warmup period for differential window calculations.

backtest.description: Configure differential equation damping coefficients, moving average windows, and target position counts for multi-universe parameter optimization.
backtest.chatText: Strategy 'diff_eq_momentum_v1' compiled successfully. 7 optimizable parameters registered (MA_window, dt_step, zeta_damping, omega_freq, RVOL_short, RVOL_med, n_top). Ready for S&P 500 optimization.
bullets: Maximizes Alpha and Sharpe ratio while strictly capping Max Drawdown.
No reliance on SPY or external benchmark logic.
Fully validated execution pipeline ready for study launch.

faq.title: Questions,
faq.description: The fast read on how Fintela works, what it costs, and where it fits.

assetClasses.q: What asset classes does Fintela support?
assetClasses.a: Currencies, U.S. equities, S&P indices, ETFs, forex, and global markets, all through the same unified strategy engine. Build a strategy once, test it across any cluster you define.

vsBacktesting.q: How is Fintela different from a standard backtesting library?
vsBacktesting.a: Fintela combines backtesting with asset groups, strategy code, Bayesian parameter optimization, train/validation/OOS evaluation, portfolio analytics, and live deployment via your connected brokerage into a single pipeline. No exports, no scripts, no glue code between tools.

python.q: Do I need to know Python?
python.a: Yes, strategies are Python functions, but Fintelligent can generate them for you. Describe what you want in plain English and the agent writes the code, configures the parameters, and stages the form for your review.

optimization.a: Fintela uses intelligent optimization, which learns from each trial to focus search on the most promising parameter regions. Every study is evaluated across three time windows: train (in sample), validation (held out), and out of sample, so robustness is built into the workflow.

seedExport.q: Can I export my strategy's signal?
seedExport.a: Yes. Every trial, basket, and sandbox run exposes its seed: the daily rebalancing signal (date → ticker → position/allocation) the engine used to build the backtest. You can inspect it date by date and download it as JSON (the exact engine input) or CSV, straight from the app.

liveTrading.a: Validated portfolios can be promoted to live operations that execute through your connected brokerage. You see real time order logs, P&L, and a one click pause. Multiple operations can run in parallel against different baskets.

security.a: Yes. Strategies and configurations are cryptographically hashed and time stamped, supporting authorship verification and auditability. The platform is fully cloud hosted.

poweredBy.q: Who is Fintelligent powered by, and is it safe?
poweredBy.a: You can choose which AI provider powers Fintelligent, from a variety of options such as DeepSeek and Anthropic, with Fintela managed access and no API key to bring. Every tool call is visible in the chat, and every irreversible action (creating/stopping a study, deploying an operation) requires your explicit confirmation before execution.

speed.q: How fast can I go from idea to live capital?
speed.a: How long it takes depends on your idea and how much you optimize, not on setting up infrastructure. There is no environment to build, no data pipeline to wire up, and no handoff between tools.
